h: Wike makes fresh claim about helping Peter Obi become a presidential candidate
p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly made a new claim about his role in Peter Obi's political journey, saying he helped put him on the path to a presidential ticket. A separate report says Wike also spoke about what could stop Obi from winning the presidency in 2027. Obi's camp has not been reported to respond.
more: Wike has repeatedly commented on Obi as the 2027 race heats up.
Obi is running on the NDC ticket with Kwankwaso.
